xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2599: PostHog v2 — opt-out, server/CLI telemetry, error tracking, flags, agent-facing docs

plan.title: PostHog integration v2: opt-out, server/CLI telemetry, error tracking, flags, agent-facing consumption
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: PR #2776 shipped posthog-js in the dashboard frontend with no opt-out: posthog.init runs unconditionally in every production build, nothing reads OVERDECK_TELEMETRY, and there is no server/CLI telemetry, no documented event schema, and no sourcemap upload for error tracking. The PAN-2599 v1 privacy model (opt-out, install UUID, documented schema) is unimplemented.
narratives.Proposal: Per PRD v2 (drafts/pan-2599.md on overdeck-state): add a runtime opt-out resolved server-side (config.yaml telemetry.enabled, env OVERDECK_TELEMETRY=0 wins) and delivered via GET /api/settings; gate the frontend by never calling posthog.init when disabled, behind a single wrapper module; add a Settings > Telemetry UI section per the mockup; add a posthog-node-backed AnalyticsService (single write door) for server + CLI events with a random install UUID as distinct_id and $process_person_profile:false; enable exception autocapture both sides plus hidden sourcemaps uploaded during release when POSTHOG_CLI_API_KEY is set; add a minimal feature-flag read door (config > flag > fallback); type the event schema in @overdeck/contracts and mirror it in docs/TELEMETRY.md with a drift-lint test; document agent-facing PostHog consumption (hosted MCP, posthog-cli).
narratives.NonGoals:
- LLM/AI-observability capture (owner: PAN-2443)
- Session replay (too invasive for a dev tool)
- Surveys, experiments, or wiring any real feature to a flag
- Pulling HogQL aggregates into the dashboard metrics page (#750 stays local-data-first)
- First-run telemetry notice (operator decision 2026-07-14 stands)
- Reading ~/.codex/, ~/.claude*, or any other tool's credential files for identity
- Raw hand-rolled $exception events (PostHog forbids; SDK paths only)

config.test.ts passes: default true, config false wins, env OVERDECK_TELEMETRY=0 beats config-enabled

PRD WI-1 has the exact snippet.

Extend the PUT handler in src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts (routes registered at lines 6-11) to persist telemetry.enabled to config.yaml. env-forced-off state must surface as enabled:false in GET.

Frontend: runtime-gated telemetry wrapper; migrate all 15 posthog call sites; no direct posthog-js imports outside the wrapper

verify_commands: bash -c "cd src/dashboard/frontend && ! git grep -l \"from 'posthog-js'\" src | grep -v lib/telemetry.ts"

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/telemetry.ts per the PRD WI-4 snippet: initTelemetry() fetches /api/settings, returns without calling posthog.init when telemetry.enabled===false (zero network guarantee — init is what contacts /flags), else inits with person_profiles:'identified_only' and capture_exceptions:true, and registers install_id as a super property. Export capture(event: TelemetryEventName, props) and captureException() that no-op before init and under import.meta.env.MODE==='test'. Replace the unconditional posthog.init in main.tsx:10-13 with void initTelemetry(). Migrate the 15 call sites enumerated in the PRD's Verified-current-state list to the wrapper.

AnalyticsService: posthog-node wrapper (single write door) with enabled/test gating, install-UUID identity, bounded shutdown flush

expected_outputs: service.test.ts passes with fake timers: capture buffers and flushes on shutdown() within the 2s cap; disabled resolver means the posthog-node constructor is never invoked (module mock)
metadata.readinessReason: Touches only new files (src/lib/telemetry/service.ts + its test) plus a package.json dep add; no overlap with wave peers settings-api or telemetry-docs. The flag-door overlap on service.ts is serialized by an explicit blocks edge.

narrative.Action: bun add posthog-node at the repo root. Create src/lib/telemetry/service.ts per PRD WI-6/D2: lazily-constructed client; every method no-ops (client never constructed) when resolveTelemetryEnabled() is false or process.env.VITEST/NODE_ENV==='test'; capture(event, props) stamps distinct_id=getOrCreateInstallId(), $process_person_profile:false, platform, arch, overdeckVersion, clientType ('cli'|'server'); shutdown() races client.shutdown() against a 2s timeout; server construction passes enableExceptionAutocapture:true. Event names typed from @overdeck/contracts. This is the single write door — no other module may import posthog-node or POST to PostHog. Tests MUST use vi.useFakeTimers()+advanceTimersByTimeAsync (repo rule), never real sleeps.

items.title: Given telemetry disabled, When capture() and shutdown() are called, Then the posthog-node constructor is never invoked and no network mock is hit — asserted by service.test.ts passing
Given telemetry enabled with a mocked client, When shutdown() is called with a hung flush, Then it resolves within the 2s fake-timer cap — asserted by service.test.ts passing
CLI: cli_command_run event + bounded flush before every process.exit path

expected_outputs: telemetry-exit.test.ts passes: the exit helper awaits shutdown() (fake timers) before exiting; disabled telemetry adds no await

narrative.Action: In src/cli/index.ts (commander program at line 164): wrap command dispatch to capture cli_command_run { verb: top-level command name, ok: boolean, durationMs: bucketed } via AnalyticsService, and add one exit helper that awaits the bounded shutdown() flush, used at the existing process.exit sites (lines ~410, 415, 857, 867, 1030, 1097) so each site stays a one-line change. Sync overhead when enabled must stay ≤10ms (fire-and-forget capture; only exit awaits flush).

items.title: Given a completed CLI command with telemetry enabled (mocked service), When the process exits through the helper, Then cli_command_run was captured with verb/ok/bucketed duration and shutdown() was awaited — asserted by telemetry-exit.test.ts passing

Given telemetry disabled, When a CLI command runs and exits, Then zero capture calls occur and the exit helper resolves immediately (no flush await) — asserted by telemetry-exit.test.ts passing with fake timers
Server: initialize AnalyticsService at boot and emit server_boot with bucketed counts

expected_outputs: server-boot-telemetry.test.ts passes: server_boot captured with bucketed projectCount/activeAgentCount; boot does not await telemetry
npm run build exits 0 (boot-path change must be runtime-boot-tested before live restart — repo rule)

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/main.ts boot path (after config load, near the runServer wiring at ~line 798): initialize AnalyticsService and fire-and-forget a server_boot event carrying bucketed projectCount and activeAgentCount (buckets: 0, 1-2, 3-5, 6-10, 11+). Boot must never block or fail on telemetry. NOTE (repo rule): this is a boot-path change — runtime-boot-test on a throwaway instance before any live restart, and use pan restart --health-timeout 120000.

items.title: Given the server boots with telemetry enabled (mocked service), When boot completes, Then exactly one server_boot event was captured with bucketed counts and boot latency is unaffected — asserted by server-boot-telemetry.test.ts passing

Pipeline funnel: pipeline_stage_changed at merge, verification, and close-out transition owners

expected_outputs: pipeline-events.test.ts passes: merged/verification_passed/closed_out stages captured with harness+model enums and no issue ids, titles, or paths in properties

narrative.Action: Emit pipeline_stage_changed { stage, harness, model } from the single-owner transition points: postMergeLifecycle() in src/lib/cloister/merge-agent.ts (stage=merged), runVerificationForIssue() in src/lib/cloister/verification-runner.ts (stage=verification_passed on pass), and the pan close flow (stage=closed_out; locate via the close command implementation — search 'closeOut'). IMPLEMENTATION CHECKPOINT (from PRD WI-6): confirm each function is the sole transition owner before emitting; if a transition has multiple owners, emit only from the server-side write door for that state and note the gap in docs/TELEMETRY.md. Properties are enums only — never issue ids, titles, repo names, or paths.

items.title: Given a mocked merge/verification/close-out flow, When each transition fires, Then exactly one pipeline_stage_changed per transition is captured and a property-shape assertion finds no string outside the declared enums — asserted by pipeline-events.test.ts passing
Given telemetry disabled, When the same transitions fire, Then zero events are captured and the flows complete unchanged — asserted by pipeline-events.test.ts passing
Hidden sourcemaps in frontend build + posthog-cli upload step in release (skip-with-warning without key)

frontend build exits 0 and dist/dashboard/public contains .map files not referenced by the served bundles

narrative.Action: Add sourcemap:'hidden' to the build block of src/dashboard/frontend/vite.config.ts (lines 79-82). In src/cli/commands/release.ts preflight (after runStreaming('npm run build', ...) at line 369): build the frontend (npm run build:dashboard:frontend), then if POSTHOG_CLI_API_KEY is set run npx @posthog/cli sourcemap inject + upload --directory dist/dashboard/public --release-version <version>; else log a warning and continue. IMPLEMENTATION CHECKPOINT (PRD WI-7): verify whether .github/workflows/release.yml or npm prepack rebuilds the frontend after preflight — if so, move inject/upload there so uploaded maps match the shipped bundle; fallback is the preflight location. Never commit .map files.

items.title: Given no POSTHOG_CLI_API_KEY in env, When the release sourcemap step runs, Then it prints a skip warning and exits 0 without any network call — asserted by release-sourcemaps.test.ts passing

Given the frontend built with sourcemap:'hidden', When inspecting dist/dashboard/public, Then .map files exist and grepping the emitted .js bundles for sourceMappingURL prints zero matches — asserted by npm run build:dashboard:frontend exiting 0 and the grep producing empty output
Feature-flag read door: isFeatureEnabled(flag, fallback) with config > flag > fallback and 500ms timeout

expected_outputs: flag-door.test.ts passes with fake timers: timeout returns fallback; disabled telemetry returns fallback without constructing the client; explicit config value beats the flag

narrative.Action: Add isFeatureEnabled(flag: string, fallback: boolean): Promise<boolean> to AnalyticsService per PRD D5/WI-8: posthog-node flag evaluation via the public /flags endpoint with the project key, raced against a 500ms timeout that resolves to fallback; disabled telemetry or offline resolves fallback; an explicit config override always wins. No production flag adoption in this issue. Fake-timer tests only (repo rule).

items.title: Given a hung flag evaluation, When isFeatureEnabled('x', true) is awaited, Then it resolves true at the 500ms fake-timer mark; Given telemetry disabled, Then it resolves the fallback with the client never constructed — asserted by flag-door.test.ts passing
Given an explicit config override for the flag's feature, When isFeatureEnabled runs, Then the config value is returned and no flag network evaluation occurs — asserted by flag-door.test.ts passing
